notes: All 7 snapshot text files (6 pages) were readable; all are Common Crawl captures, so sourceUrl is the index lookup address printed in each footer and sourceDate is the capture timestamp date. Istanbul Technical University: the English-URL page carries a Turkish table "İşletme Mühendisliği Doktora Mezunları" (Management Engineering doctoral graduates) with columns name / thesis title / graduation year (Mezuniyet) / next position / current position; the two position columns are empty for every row. Names are kept with the page's capitalisation (some surnames in capitals). Lancaster University: three job-market pages. Season ranges recorded with the closing year and the range quoted in note: 2018-19 -> 2019 (2019-10-20 capture), 2017-18 -> 2018 (2017-10-21 capture), 2015-16 -> 2016 (the 2017-10-20 capture of the older URL still carried the 2015-16 list with thesis titles and supervisors). Several people recur across seasons (Mohammed Cheded 2016 and 2018; Rui Roberto/Robert Ramos 2016, 2018 and 2019; Dhanan Utomo 2018 and 2019); rows kept separately per snapshot with names as written. "Dr. M. Isabella Cavalcanti Junqueira" is recorded with the "Dr." prefix as written. Lancaster lists are school-wide (all LUMS departments), not operations-only. Loughborough University: the repository "Business Theses" collection page shows only thesis title, author and a repository deposit timestamp (all 2019); it does not state the degree (PhD vs other research degree) or the award year, so listedYear is null with the deposit timestamp in note. Some entries (e.g. M.R. Mathews, Ian Herbert) may be older theses deposited retrospectively. Integrator should treat these as unverified thesis records, not confirmed PhD graduation years. MIT Sloan: both snapshots give "PhD YYYY" per person, recorded as graduation year, with the named school as destination; the page describes where alumni are teaching as of the snapshot ("where these recent graduates are today"), so destination is not necessarily the first job. The 2017 snapshot has 51 rows; the 2018 snapshot has 39 rows, drops many pre-2014 graduates, adds 2018 graduates, and lists Nada Hashmi under two groups (both rows kept). No Operations Management group appears on either snapshot. "Williamette University" and "University College of London" are kept as written.
